description:
Hellsing, a secret organization of the British government, has long been battling supernatural threats to keep the people safe from creatures of the night. The current leader, Integra Wingates Hellsing controls her own personal army to eliminate the undead beings, but even her highly trained soldiers pale in comparison to her most trusted vampire exterminator, a man by the name of Alucard, who is actually a powerful vampire himself. Along with Integra's mysterious butler and Alucard's new vampire minion, Seras Victoria, The Hellsing Organization must face not only regular ghouls and vampires, but a rivaling secret organization from the Vatican, and Millennium, an enigmatic group of madmen spawned by a certain war over 50 years ago...
A bloody battle between monsters is about to begin, the dead are dancing, and all hell is singing...

node.description:
__Height__: 220 cm (7'2")

The secret weapon of the Hellsing organization, Alucard is a vampire specializing in killing other vampires. At first glance, he seems to be nothing but a rather odd gunman, but when he truly unleashes his powers, it becomes quite clear that he is not a mortal. After walking the night for half a millennium, he is constantly seeking a worthy opponent, and with his powers of regeneration, strength, and shape-shifting, not to mention his army of familiars, he lays waste to any of his master's enemies.    

~!However, beneath his cool and heartless exterior lurks a dark and tragic past, and a longing for the only thing an immortal can never have.!~ 

Several of the typical weaknesses of vampires have no effect on him, like sunlight, as he claimed in chapter 13: "Sunlight is not my greatest enemy...  I just HATE it!" He can also travel over running water without any problem.

name.native: インテグラル・ファルブルケ・ウィンゲーツ・ヘルシング

node.description: Sir Integra Hellsing is a noblewoman member of the Protestant Knights who is the head and last member of the Hellsing family, the Bureau Director of the Hellsing Organization, and the current master of Hellsing's vampire, Alucard. Integra is usually a collected individual, rarely allowing her emotions to get in the way of business. However, she is sometimes prone to fits of anger. The Hellsing family is "on a mission from God", and she values her duties to protect the United Kingdom and the Anglican Church above everything else. For her, failure is not tolerated, especially her own. She runs the Hellsing Organization with charisma and patriotism, and she is one of the few people who can stand up to the force of Alucard's personality and command his respect.

name.native: セラス・ヴィクトリア

node.description:
__Affiliations:__ Hellsing Organization, London Metropolitan Police (Former; Firearms Specialist)

A policewoman sent to investigate the troubles at Cheddar Village, her squad is killed and she is nearly raped and killed by the mad vampire priest inhabiting the dead village but is "saved" when [Alucard](https://anilist.co/character/601/Alucard) sends a bullet through her to kill the priest. On the verge of death, she allows Alucard to turn her into a vampire​ and joins Hellsing as Alucard's minion.

She is reluctant to embrace her new powers at first, but gradually comes to terms with what she is, and eventually discovers her true powers after a certain event.

name.native: アレクサンド・アンデルセン神父

node.description:
Alexander Anderson is the trump card of Iscariot - section XIII, the secret organization of the Catholic church created to fight the undead.

Little is known about his background, other than his many nicknames and victories, and his biotech regeneration. Anderson first meets [Alucard](https://anilist.co/character/601/Alucard) on a mission in Northern Ireland, and their paths cross many times afterwards. Anderson is seemingly possessed by the thought of defeating Alucard... How far is he willing to go in order to defeat his foe?

name.native: ウォルター・C（クム）・ドルネーズ

node.description: Walter C. Dornez is the butler of [Integra Hellsing](https://anilist.co/character/603/), but is at the same time a deadly combatant, wielding high-velocity microfilament wires, and fought together with [Alucard](https://anilist.co/character/601/) in the Second World War to stop a certain group's attempt at creating an undead army.

name.native: エンリコ・マクスウェル

node.description: Enrico Maxwell is the leader of the Vatican's Special Section XIII, the Iscariot Organization. He is a bitter rival of Integra and the Hellsing organization, but establishes a form of cooperation with Hellsing when fighting Millenium.  But can Integra and the others truly trust him?

name.native: ピップ・ベルナドット

node.description: Pip Bernadotte; a shallow, perverted and chainsmoking French mercenary. He and his squad The Wild Geese are hired by Hellsing after Hellsing lost its own troops in the Valentine attack. Bernadotte is a well experienced soldier, and fares surprisingly well against the undead he is put against.   ~!Later in the series, he develops romantic feelings for Seras Victoria. !~

A first Lieutenant of SS in WWII, The Major was ordered by Hitler to lead the project of creating an army of Nazi vampires. Upon the defeat brought by Alucard and Walter in Poland, The Major and his officers escaped to South America. The original purpose of the Vampire project was to ensure Germany victory in WWII, but The Major now has his own agenda, preaching of endless war and destruction, and seems to pay no heed to who will be victorious.  The Major claims to be human, although he have somehow managed to retain his youth since WWII, possibly by alterations done by Doc.   ~!It appears from Hellsing Ultimate OVA 10 that The Major's body for the series was that of a robot (or of a cyborg) and he may have in fact been long dead.!~

name.native: リップ・ヴァン・ウィンクル

node.description: SS-Obersturmführer Rip van Winkle is an officer in Millennium, utilizing a long barreled flintlock musket with "magical" homing bullets. Though she is powerful, It is unknown whether she is a vampire or a modified human. She already encountered Alucard during WWII, and fears the coming of "Samiel", fashioning herself as  "Kaspar", the protagonist of the opera "Der Freischütz".  She leads the first "sortie" against the British when she lands a boarding crew aboard the British carrier HMS Eagle, killing all the crew, including the vampire operatives that had been planted on board.

The Captain is a member of the Millennium forces and the Waffen-SS.  The Captain is Major Montana Max's silent, stoic adjutant and bodyguard. Unlike the Major and Lieutenant Rip van Winkle, he still wears a full uniform, which is similar to a M42 Greatcoat with its neckguard constantly turned up, and an M43 officer's cap emblazoned with the Totenkopf symbol. The Captain is a natural werewolf, able to transform at will and fight in either human or werewolf form. Hans once fought Walter and Alucard in WWII, and meets the Hellsing forces later in London. His seemingly noble behaviour does not fit very well in with the rest of Millennium, and his enigmatic behaviour makes one wonder what he is fighting for.  The Captain possesses immense superhuman ability, even while in human form. This includes superhuman senses, strength (strong enough to bend steel bars or shatter limbs with a single kick), speed, reflexes, agility, dexterity, coordination, balance, and endurance. His iron-like flesh can withstand Walter's wires (which can easily slice solid steel), even as they are tightened around his bare neck. He seems to be able to fall great distances without sustaining any damage. The Captain has some regenerative ability, as he quickly regenerated his mutilated hand in The Dawn. In addition to his natural abilities, the Captain possesses two modified Mauser C96s with incredibly long barrels, and a combat knife that he has not used yet.  His name is not Hans, this was a fanmade name for him because of a scene where various names appeared in the background and Hans was one of them.

name.native: トバルカイン・アルハンブラ

node.description: Tubalcain Alhambra is one of Millennium's artificial vampires, but much more powerful than Luke, Jan and the basic Millennium troops. His special ability is cards, using them to attack and regenerate. He was sent to assault the hotel in which Alucard and Seras were staying, and the coming battle with Alucard became his end.

Zorin Blitz is another of Millenniums officers, charged with the mission of assaulting Hellsing HQ. Her forces are met by stiff resistance from Seras and The Geese, but her illusion abilities makes her a fearsome adversary.   Zorin's most remarkable features are her tattoos, covering one half of her body, and her weapon, a giant scythe.

The catboy Schrödinger is one of the members of the Millennium elite, a modern-day group of Nazis. He holds the power to appear "everywhere and nowhere" (his name being a direct reference to Erwin Schrödinger and his thought experiment "Schrödinger's cat"), as well as being able to regenerate fatal wounds. His combat abilities and motives are currently unknown, though Hirano has confirmed he is a creation of Doc.

name.native: ヤン・ヴァレンタイン

node.description: The youngest of the Valentine brothers, Jan is a maniacal thug and an artificial vampire. He does not have any high class vampire abilities, and utilizes two P90s.  During the assault on Hellsing HQ, he fought Seras and Walter while hunting for Integra, and was eventually remotely killed by Millennium in order to seal his lips.

name.native: ルーク・ヴァレンタイン

node.description: The older of the Valentine brothers, Luke is entirely unlike his brother, and sports a calm and composed behaviour. like Jan, he does not have any high class vampire abilities, and use a pair of sawed-off M1 Garand rifles as well as knives. Luke challenges Alucard, but grossly underestimate him, and is in the end eaten by Alucards Hellhound.

The Doc is, as his nickname implies, a doctor, though of the rather questionable sort.  He is the mastermind behind Millennium's artificial vampires, and has not aged since the second world war. He  is also in the possession of a peculiar remote controller, controlling many different aspects of the Millennium war machine.
Yumie Takagi, a Katana wielding Japanese nun, is one of Iscariot's agents, complete with a split berserker-personality and almost superhuman swordskills.

name.native: ハインケル・ウーフー

node.description: Heinkel Wolfe, a pistol wielding assassin for the Iscariot organization, joins the fray along with Yumie and a squad of Vatican gunpriests.

Father Renaldo is Father Enrico Maxwell's second-in-command of Section XIII, Iscariot Organization. He was the one who had informed Paladin Alexander Anderson of a vampire attack in Badrick, Northern Ireland... and of the Hellsing Organization's involvement in containing the attack. Like all members of Iscariot, Renaldo is fanatically devoted to the Catholic Church... and of Iscariot's holy mission.    (Source: Absolute Anime)

name.native: リチャード・ヘルシング
アーサー・ヘルシング

node.description: Descendant of the eccentric and brilliant Abraham Van Helsing, Arthur's tireless efforts in the cultivation of the Hellsing Organization coupled with his expansive knowledge of midians, sought to protect England from occult threat for decades. Arthur was the proud father of his daughter, Integra, and at his deathbed pronounced her official head of the Hellsing Organization much to his brother's displeasure.  (Source: Call To Arms)

name.native: ヒュー・アイランズ卿

node.description: The leader of the round table.
M'quive is Maxwell's successor as the Leader of the Iscariot Organization. He is seen in the final chapter where Integra won her match and then leaves with the new enforcer Heinkel Wolfe.
Yet another member of the convention of twelve.  (Source: CtA)

name.native: シェルビー・M・ペンウッド

node.description: Sir Shelby M. Penwood being a descendent from a noble family was able to inherit wealth and a hight position in British Navy even through on the surface he appears as a somewhat cowardly and incompetent man. Still Sir Penwood is a long time family friend to Hellsing household, he was a comrade to Arthur Hellsing and kept an eye on Integra after Arthur passed away. Penwood's family wealth is used to cover expenses of Hellsing organisation frequently.

Under disguise of a newly assigned priest from the small village of Cheddar concealed a dangerous vampire, he silently killed several people until villagers were able to expose the culprit, unfortunately for them, that only resulted in a slaughter to vampire's great delight.  What had happened in Cheddar did not escape the attention of the local authorities who sent there a police squad with a young police officer Seras Victoria, nor it escaped the attention of Hellsing organization and their best expert in supernatural threats, Alucard.  For Cheddar Priest it only left to wait for them accompanied by his new ghoul minions, an armed pack of mindless animated corpses, those who fell prey to the vampire.

Jessica and her boyfriend were a couple of low level youngster vampires misguided into a belief that they can become immortal by killing off 13 random families on a road. They've managed to kill 4 before clashing with Hellsing operatives to our pair's great surprise.

name.native: レイフ aka ハガー

node.description: Leif aka Huger and his girlfriend Jessica were a couple of low level youngster vampires misguided into a belief that they can become immortal by killing off 13 random families on a road. They've managed to kill 4 before clashing with Hellsing operatives to our pair's great surprise.  In Hellsing manga vampire boyfriend's name has never been mentioned so in different adaptations authors went with different versions: in Hellsing TV series he is called "Leif" multiple times while in Hellsing Ultimate character's name is never spoken out loud, yet noted as "Huger" in the end credits of episode one.

name.native: エイブラハム・ヴァン・ヘルシング

node.description: A 19th century doctor of medicine, philosophy and literature, a man with a wide area of thought all around, also an experienced vampire hunter and a direct ancestor of Sir Integra Fairbrook Wingates Hellsing.
